judge.reason: The workflow is nightly, OS-matrixed, installs per-OS as requested, checks out main, uses one appropriate two-prompt smoke test, keeps agents within one job per OS, and was committed with the push/PR limitation disclosed. However c5 is unmet: the `pi` agent, which the replay itself identified as registered and included in its initial plan, is omitted from the final agent set without any stated reason (and the run command drops the `--agent` flag in favour of an env-var mechanism added via harness code changes).
